meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按预设规则切换助手的工作模式,让它照你设定的方式执行任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让助手用一套固定指令改变自己的工作方式
copy.tagline_en: Switch the assistant into a preset work mode so it runs tasks your way
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the assistant to change how it works via a fixed set of directives

howto.what: 开启后 Claude 进入 ultrawork 模式：第一条可见输出固定为 `ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!`，接着登记目标与验收标准、把改动分为 LIGHT/HEAVY，边做边写追加式记事本，并要求先拿到先红后绿的测试证据加真实界面验证才算做完。
howto.when: 当你明确要求进入 ultrawork 模式、且该指令还不在此前对话里时，会读取并接管。任务中途出现新模块、认证、数据库 schema 等事实时会立即升级为 HEAVY。

say.text: 进入 ultrawork 模式，帮我修掉这个 bug
say.note: 首行会输出 ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式，这次改动按 HEAVY 标准做
say.note: 会登记目标并定 3 条以上验收标准

say.text: 开启 ultrawork，先写失败测试再改这个接口
say.note: 会留 RED→GREEN 证据再用 curl 验证

howto.what_en: Enables ultrawork mode: the first visible line is exactly `ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!`. Claude registers a goal with success criteria, triages LIGHT/HEAVY, keeps an append-only notepad, and must capture RED→GREEN plus real-surface evidence before done.
howto.when_en: Read when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation. Mid-task it upgrades to HEAVY if facts like a new module, auth, or a DB schema appear.

say_en.text: Enter ultrawork mode and fix this bug
say_en.note: First line will be ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!

say_en.text: Use ultrawork mode and treat this change as HEAVY
say_en.note: Registers a goal with 3+ success criteria

say_en.text: Start ultrawork: write the failing test first
say_en.note: Leaves RED→GREEN evidence, then curl proof
